description: The current (tip) TRON block: number, id, parent, timestamp, transaction count and a breakdown by contract type, plus the producing witness. When to use: how busy TRON is right now, what is in the block being produced, who produced it. Do not use: to fetch an older block - a lite full node serves the tip only, historical blocks are closed. Returns: number, block_id, parent_hash, timestamp_ms, age_s, tx_count, tx_by_type, producer_address.
name: tron_get_current_block
